hypothesis: Replace per-cell primary span vectors and shrink-to-box storage with row-owned spans and cell ranges; retain identical scan events, spans, validation and both writer paths.

allocation.scope: staged sets and MultiSourceEdit::commit; no publication/reopen/oracles

profile.scope: Separate zero-before/dump-after/toggle exact-name; fourth call only, preceding3lifecyclecalls retained

admission: Require at least 2% p50 improvement in primary total and at least 5% p50 improvement in primary commit, plus at least 2% mean improvement in primary total in both repeats of both shapes. Require at least 8% allocation-call reduction in both allocator repeats/shapes. If these pilot gates pass, require at least 3% commit Ir reduction in both shapes/repeats, full quality and eager guards before retention. Flag every >5% adverse timing, mean, RSS or incremental allocation peak and all >5% absolute same-build drift. Reject if any pilot gate fails; no profiler/hardware speedup claim then. Preserve all captured evidence. No cold/range/native-producer/scaling claim.
native_order: retained baseline native-r2 under candidate source checkout
retained_baseline_custody: Retained baseline binary and build manifest remain hash-bound; candidate checkout source is independently bound during final A2 and differs only in the frozen candidate file inventory.
resource_scope: Existing limits/fences unchanged. Row span growth window and allocation topology change; all retained span data remains live with Layout until drop.

hardware.scope: Whole fresh child including corpus/setup/publication/oracles; diagnostic only, not isolated commit counters.

candidate_source_binding: Exact source file inventory and SHA256 values captured independently for each stage; candidate diff must be nonempty and entirely within candidate_source_roots. Harness source is identical. Review exact production/test patch before application.

conditional_lanes.profile: Required for retention only after pilot gates pass; preserved baseline binaries may run under candidate checkout.
conditional_lanes.hardware: Diagnostic only after pilot gates pass.
conditional_lanes.eager: Required before retention; no primary gain claim.
